shell_commands: git log --oneline -8 && git status && git diff HEAD~1 --stat
grep -E '"(test|typecheck|prettier)"' package.json; ls scripts/spec-links/ 2>/dev/null || echo "NO reanchor script"

grep -n "runs onError and afterSession when beforeSession throws" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts; grep -n "runs with the session untouched when beforeSession throws" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; grep -rn "beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts#\|chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L145\|chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L213" specs/ docs/ adrs/ 2>/dev/null
sed -n '213,216p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; echo ---; grep -c "validated by" specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; grep -rn "chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L2" specs/ | wc -l

for f in specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; do
  grep -oE '\[validated by: [^]]+\]\(\.\./\.\./src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator(\.beforeSession)?\.acceptance?[^)]*\.test\.ts#L[0-9]+\)|\[validated by: [^]]+\]\(\.\./\.\./src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator\.test\.ts#L[0-9]+\)' "$f" | sed 's/\[validated by: //; s/\]([^-]*//; s/)(/ /' 
done 2>/dev/null | head -5
echo "=== instead, direct: list it( titles with line numbers ==="
grep -n "it('" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | sed 's/async.*//; s/ *$//'

git status --short && npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && npx prettier --check src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
git diff src/orchestration/ specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | head -80; git diff --stat
git diff specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md | grep -E "^[+-]" | grep -vE "^[+-]{3}" | head -60

git add src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(orchestrator): fix lint and type findings in beforeSession tests

CI's verdict on the previous push named three findings: the acceptance
test built a PromptBuilder with keys PromptBuilderConfig does not have
(baseSystemPrompt -> identity), and both beforeSession tests carried
more than one expect, which re-lint/max-expects rejects. Both tests now
follow the file's established shape: the rejection is read as a value
via outcomeOf and asserted in one toEqual. The re-anchored #Lnn links
in the specs follow the shifted test lines.

Refs #94

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git push origin HEAD
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit 2>&1 | tail -5
